comparison.objective: Cap and sort four pens; candidate preassembles a collet into a clamping nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated axial cap insertion and planar sorting versus marked eccentric entry with tilt-and-roll snap engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Matching caps retained and pens released in color areas versus one collet retained continuously around the eccentric ring.
comparison.reason: Generic push-fit retention is insufficient for overlap; the candidate's eccentric changing-axis capture is meaningfully different. Its force threshold is missing.
